name: @superschematic/http-runtime
description: Runtime for generated TypeScript API servers: request context, RFC 9457 problem envelope, success envelope, parameter decoding over the superscalar scalar functions, the permission gate, a token-bucket rate limiter, and the Hono adapter. Ships TypeScript sources. Needs superscalar next to it in node_modules; see scripts/link-local-deps.mjs.

scripts.test: node scripts/link-local-deps.mjs && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && bun test src
